name: IDE Server
description: WebSocket-based IDE context server (LSP-aligned JSON-RPC protocol). Writes transport lock files to .cockpit/ide.lock, %USERPROFILE%/.claude/ide/{port}.lock, and {xdgData}/opencode/ide/{port}.lock. Broadcasts editor selection state to connected WebSocket clients using `selection_changed` JSON-RPC notification. Supports initialize handshake with protocolVersion '2025-11-25'. Instances: single exported singleton `ideServer`.

api.description: Client sends initialize request, server responds with protocolVersion and serverInfo
Server broadcasts current editor selection state to all connected clients

interface.constructor: new IdeServer() — no constructor arguments, initializes with null server/wss/port

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:0, attaches WebSocketServer, writes lock files to .cockpit/, ~/.claude/ide/, and XDG opencode/ide/ directories

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Closes all WebSocket connections, shuts down HTTP server, removes all lock files, resets port to 0

methods.name: updateEditorState
methods.description: Broadcasts selection_changed JSON-RPC notification to all connected WebSocket clients, computes relative path from workspace root

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the current server port (0 if not running)

methods.name: getLockPaths
methods.description: Returns a copy of current lock file paths

lifecycle.created_by: Module-level instantiation: `export const ideServer = new IdeServer()` — created once at import
lifecycle.destroyed_by: stop() called by main.ts when workspace closes; server and all connections torn down
